notes.text: **Blocked** (needs_input, attempt 1): Configuring branch protection is a repo setting with a release-breaking failure mode: require PRs and 'npm version && git push --follow-tags' from docs/releasing.md stops working. Operator picks which of the three shapes to take, then unblocks. The card's analysis is complete.

Operator analysis (supervisor session): recommend the first option, with one correction to the card's reasoning. 'Require status checks without requiring PRs' does NOT leave direct pushes intact for everyone: a required check blocks any push of a commit that lacks a passing run, which a fresh commit never has. It works here only because enforce_admins stays OFF and every human push is the admin: (1) worker/agent PRs: gh pr merge refuses to merge before test + packed-artifact are green (without --admin), which is exactly the invariant we want made mechanical; (2) the release runbook (npm version patch; git push --follow-tags) keeps working because the admin bypasses; (3) supervisor docs pushes (wiki commits) also bypass as admin. The honest caveat: the gate binds only non-admin paths, so an admin gh pr merge --admin or direct push can still skip CI — the invariant is enforced against automation, kept by discipline for the human. If you want it airtight instead, that is the card's third option (version bump via PR, tag the merge commit) — a real releasing.md change. Concretely, option 1 is: gh api -X PUT repos/emyann/harness-kanban-board/branches/main/protection with required_status_checks {strict:false, checks: [test, packed artifact]}, enforce_admins false, required_pull_request_reviews null, restrictions null. Say the word (or run it) and unblock this card.

results.summary: Option 1 applied to main: required status checks 'test' and 'packed artifact', no required pull requests, strict=false (branches need not be up to date), enforce_admins=false. Verified live via the protection API. enforce_admins is false on purpose: required checks apply to direct pushes too, so enforcing them on admins would block the release runbook's 'npm version && git push --follow-tags' — the commit has no checks on it until after it lands. With it false, an accidental merge of a red or unfinished PR is blocked by default and clearing it is a deliberate admin override, which is the behaviour worth buying; the release push keeps working. No CLI change, no adopter impact: this is a setting on this repository only. Unblocks #89.
